verse: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
story: Standing outside a sealed tomb, with Lazarus four days dead, Jesus says something no teacher had said before.

Martha believed in a resurrection on the last day. Jesus moves it from a distant event to a Person standing in front of her: He is the resurrection and the life. Those who trust Him will live even after they die. Death is real enough that Jesus wept at the grave, yet it does not have the final word over anyone who belongs to Him.
If you are grieving, or afraid of your own ending, bring it to Him. He is not only able to help; He is the answer.
